apps.name: Harbor
apps.title: Harbor, a community chat
apps.description: Sign in, then hop between servers and channels, send messages with code blocks and mentions, react, reply, edit and delete, toggle the member list and re-theme the whole app from one accent color.
features: Member list with roles and presence
Settings with theme and accent color

apps.name: Stack
apps.title: Stack, a kanban board
apps.description: Drag cards between lists, open a card to edit labels, checklist, due date, members and comments, filter and search the board, add and rename lists, and pick a board color that themes everything.
features: Card details with checklist and comments

apps.name: Tidal
apps.title: Tidal, a calendar
apps.description: Day, week, month and agenda views with a mini month, color coded calendars, overlapping events laid out side by side, a live current time line, drag to move and a full event editor.
features: Day, week, month and agenda views
Click a slot to create an event
